route. soland reports the new lag count after the override Control Move
landed; the page uses this to render an immediate "now caught up"
confirmation toast without waiting for a re-fetch round-trip.

control_move_id.description: Control Move id of the override commit.

lag_count.description:
New lag count after the override landed. Typically 0; non-zero
means new governance Seals landed concurrently and the admin has
to retry.

soland_contracts.admin.covered_seals.Cov.description: Snapshot returned by the covered-seals admin describe endpoint.

covered_seals.description: Governance Seal ids the MLS group has acknowledged.

governance_seals.description: Governance Seal ids the current MLS epoch should cover.

mls_epoch.description:
Current MLS group epoch — a monotonically-increasing integer that
the group bumps on every Add/Remove/Update.

soland_contracts.admin.device_signing_di.description: One authorized, non-revoked device signing key.
Response from the product-local device signing-key directory.
Request for the product-local device signing-key directory.

soland_contracts.admin.queries.AdminActo.description:
One actor row in the admin actors projection.

Sourced from the account store joined with the lifecycle registry and the
admin-principal configuration. `id` is the canonical actor id (the DID
string) and is always present.

account_id.description:
Durable surrogate account row id (`ak:account:<uuid7>`), stable across
DID rotation. Account-lifecycle admin endpoints address accounts by
DID, not by this id.

deactivation_federation_incomplete.description:
`Some(true)` when the account is deactivated locally but at least one
federated peer has not confirmed the deactivation. `None` when the
account is not deactivated or the fanout state is unknown.

is_admin.description:
Whether the DID is listed as an admin principal. `None` = the
authorization source was unavailable (never a defaulted `false`).

last_active_at.description: Last activity timestamp. `None` = not tracked by this deployment.

allOf.description:
Account lifecycle status. `None` = the lifecycle registry could not
answer for this DID (never a defaulted `Active`).

soland_contracts.integration.capability_.description: Post-projection authorization state the fanout handler observed.
Response from the soland fanout handler.

soland_http.gc.GcCandidate.description:
One GC candidate row. Keep the surface tiny — sodmin / ops only need
enough to render a list view; full Move bytes are a follow-up.

reason.description: Reason this Move is GC-eligible, e.g. "not_in_live_seal_coverage".

total.description: Total number of cells matching the filter (before pagination).

bottom.description: Structured bottom diagnostic when `state="bottom"`; absent otherwise.

bottom_policy.description:
Bottom policy wire string from the cell registry binding.
`"reject"` (safety-critical) or `"expose"` (display state).

cell_id.description: Canonical wire form of the cell id (`ak:cell:<family>:<subject>`).

lattice.description:
Lattice kind wire string from the cell registry binding.
One of `or-set` / `cas-register` / `fsm` / `ordered-log` /
`mv-register` / `counter`.

state.description:
`"value"` when the cell holds a resolved JSON value; `"bottom"` when
the join produced a `Bottom(_)` diagnostic; `"absent"` when the
cell exists in the registry but has never been written.

value.description: Resolved JSON value when `state="value"`; absent otherwise.

soland_http.routing.admin.control.AdminC.description:
Response body — reports how many subscribers received the frame
(best-effort; broadcast::send returns the receiver count at the moment
of send, not delivery confirmation).

broadcast.description:
`true` if the broadcast was attempted; `false` only if the channel
was closed (server is shutting down).

kind.description: The kind that was emitted: `"resync_required"` or `"unauthorized"`.

receivers.description:
Number of receivers active at send time. `0` is normal — it means
no clients are currently subscribed to this Realm.

soland_http.routing.admin.control.AdminC.description:
Request body for the resync-required / unauthorized triggers. Both
endpoints share a target Space and a free-form reason surfaced verbatim
to subscribers in the control frame. `reconnect_after_ms` applies only to
`resync_required`.

realm_id.description: The Space whose subscribers should receive the frame.

reason.description:
Free-form reason string. Surfaced verbatim in the NDJSON frame
as the `reason` field for client-side telemetry / UX.

reconnect_after_ms.description: Optional minimum reconnect delay for `resync_required` frames.

soland_contracts.admin.delivery_binding..description: One row in the delivery-binding handover audit panel.
One row in the per-Realm member-routability table.

soland_http.routing.admin.media.RealmMed.description:
Effective `ak.component.realm.media_service.v1` cell, surfaced read-only
for sodmin. Mirrors the projected media_service epoch shape: the service
DID plus the declared multi-focus set (`bindings/livekit.md` §2 /
`media-service-binding.md` §2).

soland_http.routing.admin.server_ops.Adm.description:
`GET /_soland/admin/server/info` response. Mirrors sodmin's
`ServerInfo` DTO (`sodmin/src/types/server.rs`). Node version / build /
key config the operator dashboard surfaces at a glance.

allow_public_registration.description:
Whether the deployment accepts public self-registration according to
the canonical account registration policy DTO.

soland_http.routing.admin.server_ops.Adm.description:
`GET /_soland/admin/server/stats` response. Mirrors sodmin's
`ServerStats` DTO. Counts are best-effort snapshots off the live
persistence / projection stores; unavailable counters fall back to 0.

soland_http.routing.events.projection_qu.description:
One relation edge in the `org.arkret.soland.relations.list` response.
Mirrors the projected [`SolandRelationState`] fields surfaced by the
product-private `/_soland/self/relations` read. `fields` stays a free-form
`serde_json` map (arbitrary relation payload values).

Strongly-typed response body for `org.arkret.soland.strands.get`
(`GET /_soland/self/strands/{strand_id}`). This is a soland product-private
projection read (`/_soland/self/*` negative-space root); the SDK does not —
and per `service-http-binding.md` §2.1.3 should not — define a response type
for it, so the DTO lives here next to its only handler. Field set and JSON
shape mirror the materialized `StrandProjection` row plus the derived
board/list position fields. `state` / `fields` keep `serde_json` free-form
types: `state` is a small projected enum already rendered as a string and
`fields` is an arbitrary materialized key/value map.

soland_http.routing.extensions.applet_ma.description:
On-wire applet manifest envelope. The bot/ghost actor registration
strand in `applet-integration.md` Section 4 takes one of these, verifies it,
and (if accepted) mints a `bot_actor_id` bound to the manifest.

metadata.description:
Free-form manifest metadata (display_name, namespace, bridge_url,
etc.). Not interpreted by the verifier.

requested_capabilities.description:
Capabilities the applet is asking for; checked against
[`KNOWN_APPLET_CAPABILITIES`].

schema_hash.description:
sha256(canonical-bytes(applet.schema.json)) at manifest build
time. The verifier recomputes this and rejects on mismatch.

signature.description:
Base64-url (no padding) Ed25519 signature over the manifest body
(everything except this field), canonical-JSON encoded.

signer_public_key.description:
Base64-url (no padding) of the Ed25519 verifying key bound to
`signer_did`. Carried inline for the stub verifier so we can
run without the full DID resolver chain.

fanout_topology.description:
Echo of [`crate::config::FederationFanoutTopology::as_str`] so the calling
peer can reason about whether to fan out to other nodes.

soland_http.routing.federation.move_seal.description:
Response body — mirrors `SubmitSealOutcome` but reports `None` when
there were no pending Moves to seal.

published.description: `true` if a Seal was published; `false` if nothing was pending.

max_control_moves.description:
Maximum number of pending Control Moves to consume in this pass.
Default 100 if absent.

realm_id.description: Realm whose pending Moves should be batch-sealed.

soland_http.routing.federation.move_seal.description:
Response from `POST /_soland/peer/moves`.

`state` is one of `pending` / `rejected` so callers can distinguish
"we've stashed it for the next notary batch" from "verifier said no
before we even reached the queue".

device_enrollment_authority_did.description:
DID (`did:key:z…`) of the device enrollment authority the registering
client designates in the inception document via a
`ArkretDeviceEnrollmentAuthority` service entry (decision 0002 / D1).
When present it MUST be reflected in the reconstructed document so the
SCID + log proof verify; absent for callers that designate no authority.

governance.description:
Genesis-declared organization governance threshold (identity-did.md §8).
`{ "threshold": { "required": N, "eligible_methods": [...] } }`. When
present it is written into `parameters.governance` so every later
rotation MUST clear the N-of-M quorum. The registering client MUST
include the same value it signed over.

did.description: The DID whose `did.jsonl` history a rotation entry is appended to.

log_entry.description:
The next `did:webvh` log entry, already shaped by the client:
`versionId` (`<seq>-<multibase-multihash>`), `versionTime`, `parameters`
(`updateKeys`, optional `witnesses` / `witness_threshold`), `state`
(the new DID document), `proof[]` (controller / recovery / governance
signatures), and optional `witness[]` attestations. soland appends it
verbatim and re-validates the whole chain (hash chain, SCID, witness
quorum, rotation authorisation) before persisting.

soland_http.routing.realms.MemberApplica.description:
A single member-application entry in the join-policy read surface.

Reviewers (holders of the policy `review_capability`, the Realm owner, or
the applicant themselves) see the full `answers`; other callers see only the
`application_pending` placeholder, honouring `applicant_visibility=reviewer_only`
(join-policy.md §3 #2, §8.1). Exactly one of `answers` / `application_pending`
is present per entry.

answers.description:
Applicant-supplied answers, present only when the viewer is authorised
to read the application body.

application_pending.description: Placeholder flag (`true`) shown to viewers who may not read the body.

application_receipt_digest.description: Canonical receipt digest of the application record.

soland_http.routing.realms.MemberApplica.description:
Outcome of the product-local member-application listing
(`org.arkret.soland.member_application.query.list`).

allOf.description: The Realm the applications are scoped to.

viewer_is_reviewer.description: Whether the viewer holds the join-policy `review_capability`.

trust_level.description: C33.1: trust state of the cached snapshot returned by the fetch path.

auth_modes.description:
Upstream-advertised authentication modes (`bearer`, `signed_request`,
`mtls`, …). Outbound delivery binds its signing posture to this list
instead of assuming a fixed mode.

privacy_mode.description:
Upstream-advertised privacy mode for the notify payload (`blind_wakeup`,
`event_summary`, …). Used by the delivery loop to know whether the
payload must remain opaque.

service_id.description:
The upstream service DID. Required for trust-level promotion: imports
only land at `trust_level=trusted` if this DID is in the operator's
`push_bridge_trusted_service_ids` allowlist.
